label: A distinct esse cause present whenever its effect is, in every history, is depended on for being
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred (co-presence to dependence): in the given model, if c, distinct from x, causes x's esse (CausesIn c x esse) and, in every history of the model, c is present at every moment at which x is present (History.IsAt), then x depends for its being on c (DependsForBeing x c, DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING: x would not be if c were not, including impossible antecedents). Meaning: a strict conditional over the model's histories (no history has x at a moment without c then) is read as yielding the counterfactual. Warrant: in the standard counterfactual logics (Lewis, Stalnaker) a strict conditional over the relevant worlds entails the counterfactual, vacuously when the antecedent is impossible. Two conditions are not typed. (i) History coverage: the model's histories must represent the alternatives relevant to the counterfactual. Without it the bridge fails in an ordinary case: on a one-history model a parent that only originates its child and happens to outlive it is a cause of the child's esse present whenever the child is, yet the child would be without the parent. Coverage is a dependency shared by every premise of a route stated over the same model. (ii) It identifies the agent-cause counterfactual of DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING with the counterfactual a strict conditional yields; that definition lists Lewis-style dependence as an account to test against. The CausesIn antecedent blocks dependence on co-existents with no causal role; it does not block vacuous dependence on a cause of esse present at every moment of every history, whatever its mode. Its antecedent is pointwise and over all histories, so it suffices for both readings of 'would not be' (would never have been; would not be at that moment). One direction only; not a definition of DependsForBeing.
